title: The Integrated Calibration Index (ICI) and related metrics for quantifying the calibration of logistic regression models

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《The Integrated Calibration Index (ICI) and related metrics for quantifying the calibration of logistic regression models》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Assessing the calibration of methods for estimating the probability of the occurrence of a binary outcome is an important aspect of validating the performance of risk-prediction algorithms.

evidence.text: Assessing the calibration of methods for estimating the probability of the occurrence of a binary outcome is an important aspect of validating the performance of risk-prediction algorithms.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《The Integrated Calibration Index (ICI) and related metrics for quantifying the calibration of logistic regression models》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】We illustrate the utility of the ICI, E50, and E90 by using them to compare the calibration of logistic regression with that of random forests and boosted regression trees for predicting mortality in patients hospitalized with a heart attack.

evidence.text: We illustrate the utility of the ICI, E50, and E90 by using them to compare the calibration of logistic regression with that of random forests and boosted regression trees for predicting mortality in patients hospitalized with a heart attack.
